name: SET domain bifurcated histone lysine methyltransferase 1

function.text: SETDB1 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETDB1. Annotated molecular activities include histone H3 methyltransferase activity and histone H3K9 dimethyltransferase activity. It participates in heterochromatin organization and DNA methylation-dependent constitutive heterochromatin formation.

function.text: SETDB1 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETDB1. It is a histone methyltransferase that specifically trimethylates 'Lys-9' of histone H3 (H3K9me3). H3 'Lys-9' trimethylation represents a specific tag for epigenetic transcriptional repression by recruiting HP1 (CBX1, CBX3 and/or CBX5) proteins to methylated histones. H3 'Lys-9' trimethylation is coordinated with DNA methylation.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SETDB1 have been reported in colon adenocarcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.
